# slashloop

> slashloop watches short-form video in your niche (TikTok first), scores every
> post against its own creator's baseline, and flags the outliers — the videos
> that massively over-performed. Then it turns each outlier into assets you can
> ship: the extracted hook, rewritten variations, a shot-by-shot brief, a
> script, and AI hook tests that generate four alternative openings to pit
> against each other. Built for app developers using short-form video to grow
> installs — beginners at content, fluent with agents and CLIs.

The product loop: **track niche → rank outliers → extract what worked →
generate your version → test openings → track results.**

Drive it by chat through MCP, or by hand in the web app — both hit the same
account and the same credit balance.

## Connect

- [MCP server](https://mcp.slashloop.dev/mcp): add `https://mcp.slashloop.dev/mcp`
  as a custom connector (Claude Desktop, Cowork, claude.ai) or point any MCP
  client at it. First call opens a sign-in + consent flow.
- [Web app](https://slashloop.app): sign in at
  [login](https://slashloop.app/login). Key surfaces:
  [Discover](https://slashloop.app/discover) (keyword-driven source ideas),
  [Sources](https://slashloop.app/sources),
  [Gallery](https://slashloop.app/gallery) (scored outliers),
  [Hook tests](https://slashloop.app/tests),
  [Studio](https://slashloop.app/studio) (post log, weekly retro),
  [Account](https://slashloop.app/account).

## What the tools do

Roughly fifty MCP tools; the ones that matter most, by job:

- **Find sources:** `discover`, `suggest_sources` — keyword-driven suggestions
  you can track directly.
- **Track a niche:** `create_source` (hashtags, creators, keywords),
  `refresh_source`, `list_due_sources`, `delete_source`.
- **Read results:** `get_feed`, `get_outlier_summary`, `get_benchmark`,
  `get_video`, `get_video_transcript`, `search_library`.
- **Turn an outlier into assets:** `analyze_video` explains why it worked;
  `extract_hook`, `generate_hook_variations`, `create_brief`,
  `generate_script` produce the remake material.
- **AI hook tests:** `start_hook_test` mines one proven video into an editable
  insight ("the lock") plus four alternative openings — recognition,
  specific-number, contrarian, demo-first. `pick_hook_versions` keeps the
  contenders, `reroll_hooks` regenerates under the lock, `export_shotlist`
  renders a markdown shoot plan, `close_hook_test` archives the test — with
  `winner` naming the opening that beat the original ("C won").
- **Keep the loop running:** boards (`save_to_board`), an idea queue with due
  dates (`create_idea`, `list_ideas`), `get_weekly_retro` for your own account,
  and `get_digest` for the weekly breakout email.

## Costs

1 credit = $0.01. Reading anything is free. Spending roughly: refresh/discover
≈ 1.5 credits per video fetched, analyze 5, extract/variations/brief/script
steps 2, start or re-roll a hook test 2. Every money-spending tool states its
cost before it charges, and failed calls refund automatically.

## Plans

- **Free** — $0: 300 credits/month, 2 sources, manual refresh.
- **Creator** — $29/mo or $290/yr: 3,000 credits/month, 10 sources, scheduled
  weekly refresh.
- **Pro** — $79/mo or $790/yr: 10,000 credits/month, 30 sources, daily
  refresh, alerts, direct API access.
- Pay-as-you-go credit top-ups from $10 — no subscription required.

Checkout at [pricing](https://slashloop.app/pricing); balance, top-up and
billing portal at [account](https://slashloop.app/account).
